name: ca
description: Ask a fresh Claude session to review branch and local changes, implement a milestone plan test-first in an isolated worktree, and provide the bounded internal second opinion used by ca dual review.

interface.shortDescription: Peer review and development with Claude
interface.longDescription: Request an independent Claude review with no plan or PR required, or implement a milestone plan in an isolated worktree with Claude checkpoints and final review before promotion to ready.
defaultPrompt: Use $ca-implement-plan to build a saved plan with Claude review rounds.
Use $ca-ask-claude-review to review my branch and local changes against the default branch.
